entities.name: Network-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to de-register a UE from the 5G system.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate de-registration of the UE.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to accept the de-registration request from the network.

entities.name: De-registration type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of de-registration being performed.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state where the UE is not registered with the network.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
The procedure includes receiving a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message.
The DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the De-registration type information element.
The procedure requires the UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
Successful completion of the procedure establishes the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
